Reference image: attached approved Councillion court environment is STYLE ONLY: keep the same medium-fine crisp pixel clusters, dark navy outlines, restrained textures, aquatic blue palette, little warm brass accents. Do not copy its stage composition.

A tiny scales-of-justice carving on the bell's front. The middle 65 percent opens into tranquil water, drifting tiny fish silhouettes and soft diagonal sunlight. Stone dock and pale sand only along bottom 15 percent, with a low wooden ledge at each lower corner; a clear central launch gap into deeper water. Layered distant reef silhouettes give depth. Restrained amber lanterns, small shells and two subtle coral clusters.
This is game background art under functional HTML controls: leave the center uncluttered and calm and keep contrast there low. No writing, no text, no UI boxes, no numerals, no characters, no logos, no screens, no futuristic equipment, no photorealism, no 3D render, no painterly microtexture, no huge coarse voxel blocks. Match the reference's deliberate illustrated pixel look and make this visually distinct from a Feud studio. Landscape 16:9.
